about_the_game:
Welcome to Pang Hu: Island Tycoon (我不是胖虎：小岛大当家) — an adorable island management sim brought to life by Bu Er Ma, the creator of the beloved "I'm Not Fat Tiger" (我不是胖虎) IP!

Get ready to whisk yourself away to a vibrant, sun-kissed island where you'll team up with the one-and-only Pang Hu (Fat Tiger) and his pal Little Yellow (小黄毛). Together, you'll help a delightful cast of animal residents build, manage, and transform this little slice of paradise into your very own dream island!

Here's what you can look forward to:

🏝️ Island Industry & Production Chains

  • Construct and upgrade everything from bustling crop fields to efficient processing plants, creating a seamless flow from raw resources to valuable goods.

  • Fulfill orders through the "Avian Express" (飞鸟驿站) to rake in Gold, EXP, and crucial development materials.

  • Your trusty "Harbor" (码头) will keep a steady supply of exclusive building materials coming, perfect for expanding your warehouse, unlocking new plots of land, and erecting brand-new structures.

🐾 Befriend & Nurture Animal Pals

  • Embark on fun explorations across the island to gather materials and help your animal friends level up their skills.

  • Build the "Town Hall" (镇公所) and assign your trained animal companions to give specific buildings a production boost (don't worry, it won't affect their other important island duties!).

  • Grant your animals' wishes for their favorite buildings! This boosts the island's overall "Appeal" (宜居度) and can unlock charming special events.

  • Through daily interactions, you'll uncover their unique backstories and deepen your bonds.

🏆 Compete in the Animal Sports Gala!

  • Train your animal buddies and enter them into exciting seasonal ranked tournaments. Win medals and exchange them for rare and valuable items!

🤝 Team Up with Guilds!

  • Create your own guild or join an existing one! Collaborate with fellow island managers to complete weekly tasks and climb the leaderboards together.

  • Help each other out by donating resources, making those high-value orders a breeze to complete.

  • Rack up contribution points and redeem them for exclusive, hard-to-get goodies.

🎣 Relaxing Fishing & Your Own Aquarium

  • Kick back with some leisurely fishing and try to collect every type of fish the island has to offer, unlocking cool achievements along the way.

  • Show off your rarest catches in the island's grand Aquarium, curating your very own personalized aquatic wonderland.

🏡 Design Your Unique Island Paradise

  • Unleash your inner architect! Freely plan your island's layout, customizing the placement of buildings and your overall decorative style.

  • Unlock a wide array of themed decorations to craft truly one-of-a-kind scenic spots and themed areas.

As you progress, even more animal friends will be drawn to your thriving island, each bringing new, distinctive buildings and adding to the joy of island life!

Come join us! Let's create a wonderfully relaxing and charming haven on this island brimming with fun and delightful challenges.

We'll be announcing more information very soon, so keep your eyes peeled!
